title: real-time field drift explainer & sampled replay prober for structured-output rollouts
creator: Arielle Park
description:
Goal: Detect and explain quality regressions in JSON/structured outputs that are tied to model or config rollouts, and provide an automated sampled-replay probe that collects high-fidelity examples for triage and rollback decisions. This ticket builds a lightweight, realtime per-field drift explainer that combines token-level surprise, schema-conformance deltas, and config-delta weighting to surface the most likely causal changes when a rollout increases schema violations or field-level value drift. The system should integrate with the rollout controller to trigger sampled replay jobs and populate an evidence panel in the Console.

Why: Current structured-output regressions are noisy and often require manual sampling across many requests and configs. Engineers and PMs need a compact explanation (e.g., which fields and which config delta correlate with the failure) plus a reproducible set of requests to run through debug environments or run evals against a pinned model/config.

Non-goals: This ticket does not implement automated rollback; it only suggests rollback with explainability artifacts. It also does not replace the full eval harness for periodic regression sweeps — it augments rollout-time observability.
acceptance_criteria: Realtime per-field drift score emitted to telemetry for each rollout (per-model-config) with a configurable window and baseline
Top-3 explanatory attributions for each flagged field (token-level surprise, schema mismatch token positions, and config-delta weight), surfaced as a short summary string
When drift exceeds threshold, the rollout controller triggers a sampled replay job that captures original requests, model outputs, schema diffs, and minimal context for reproduction
Console panel shows: drift trend, top impacted fields, attribution summary, and a downloadable sampled-replay bundle (NDJSON)
Unit and integration tests covering drift scoring logic, attribution ranking, and replay trigger conditions
Playbook entry created with examples and recommended triage steps (links in the ticket)
End-to-end latency overhead for telemetry instrumentation < 2% p50 for typical traffic when enabled
Alerting rule created that ties drift score -> PagerDuty only when customer_impact is high and rollout in production
implementation_steps: Design drift scoring: combine field-level token perplexity delta, schema-violation rate, and config-delta priority weight; propose formula and thresholds
Add instrumentation hooks in inference router to emit compact per-request schema-conformance and token-surprise metrics (binary + top tokens) to the telemetry stream
Build an attribution service that consumes telemetry, computes per-field top-k contributing tokens and config deltas, and stores a short explanation string
Integrate with rollout controller: add a canary-hook that evaluates drift scores and triggers sampled-replay job when policy satisfied
Implement sampled-replay job: sample N requests from canary window, save original input, model output, model+config snapshot, and schema-diff; store bundle in S3 and surface link in Console
Console: add evidence panel for rollouts with drift chart, attribution summary, replay bundle download, and quick links to open GitHub issue or start a rollback flow
End-to-end tests + load test to validate telemetry overhead and false-positive rate against synthetic workloads
Documentation & runbook: write triage steps, example grooves for investigating attributions, and guidance for setting thresholds per-customer
